item.title: Martin Campbell Shuts Down the James Bond Codename Theory Once and For All
item.description: For years fans have debated whether James Bond is a single person or a rotating identity passed from agent to agent. It has been discussed endlessly online, but according to Martin Campbell, the idea does not hold up.
